{"script":"cat > sum_logs.sh <<'EOF'
#!/usr/bin/env bash
sum=0
now=$(date +%s)
threshold=$(date -d '6 days ago' +%s)
is_prime(){
  n=$1
  if [ "$n" -lt 2 ]; then return 1; fi
  if [ "$n" -eq 2 ]; then return 0; fi
  if [ $((n%2)) -eq 0 ]; then return 1; fi
  i=3
  while [ $((i*i)) -le "$n" ]; do
    if [ $((n%i)) -eq 0 ]; then return 1; fi
    i=$((i+2))
  done
  return 0
}
for f in log_files/log_server_*_*.txt; do
  [ -e "$f" ] || continue
  id=$(echo "$f" | sed -E 's/.*log_server_([0-9]+)_.*/\1/')
  d=$(echo "$f" | sed -E 's/.*_([0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2})\.txt/\1/')
  file_ts=$(date -d "$d" +%s 2>/dev/null) || continue
  if [ "$file_ts" -lt "$threshold" ] || [ "$file_ts" -gt "$now" ]; then continue; fi
  is_prime "$id" || continue
  file_sum=$(awk '{s+=$1} END{print s+0}' "$f")
  sum=$((sum + file_sum))
done
echo "$sum"
EOF
chmod +x sum_logs.sh
./sum_logs.sh
"}
